description:
Get canonical EDGAR company profile

Return a canonical SEC/EDGAR company profile for a CIK with provenance metadata. The response is strictly EDGAR-derived and does not include enrichment.

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193), or a ticker symbol (for example AAPL). A ticker resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.

name: edgar_companies
